reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Store Kafka node certificates in separate Secrets, one Secret per pod", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: After the upgrade, Kafka node certificates are stored in separate Secrets, one Secret per pod; the changelog states no failure, rejected resource or required operator action, only the changed storage layout.

proposed.statement: Kafka node certificates are now stored in separate Secrets, one Secret per pod.
